labels.executed_by_candidate: Isolated stdlib-only Python sandbox (mcp python_execute). Receipts include code/data sha256, stdout sha256, exit code, and sandbox limits. These are isolated component checks; they do not establish full-application behavior.
labels.proposed: UNEXECUTED checks planned for implementation/validation; no receipts exist and none are invented.

executed.title: Coordinate storage precision: float32 vs float64 vs JSON round-trip
executed.rationale: Brief requires enough precision to reopen and export reliably; need a discriminating check that float32 is insufficient at realistic pixel coordinates and that JSON binary64 round-trips exactly.
executed.expected: float32 introduces measurable index error at ~1e5 px; float64 JSON round-trip is exact; float32 value itself round-trips through JSON (because it is representable in binary64) — showing the loss happens at storage width, not serialization.
executed.stdout:
float64 stored px : 104857.6
float32 stored px : 104857.6015625 err_px = 0.001562499994179234
physical um f64   : 6815.744000000001
physical um f32   : 6815.74365234375 err_um = 0.0003476562505966285
roundtrip f32 px  : 104857.6015625 err_px = 0.001562499994179234
json roundtrip exact: True
json text: {"x_um": 6815.744000000001, "y_px": 104857.6}
float32 value in json: {"x_um": 6815.74365234375} -> reloaded equal: True
scope_limits: single-point demonstration at one scale/coordinate; error scales with coordinate magnitude
does not test any real viewer or file format

executed.title: Affine composition order discriminates transform conventions
executed.rationale: Brief requires explicit representation of origin/axis order/scale/display transforms; need a check that composition order is observable and therefore must be a pinned schema constant.
executed.expected: translate∘scale ≠ scale∘translate for the same point and matrices; concrete differing outputs demonstrate the ambiguity the schema must remove.
executed.stdout:
p                : (1.0, 1.0)
translate->scale : (22.0, 84.0)
scale->translate : (12.0, 24.0)
orders equal     : False
S then T matrix  : [[2.0, 0.0, 10.0], [0.0, 4.0, 20.0], [0.0, 0.0, 1]]
scope_limits: pure arithmetic on 3x3 matrices, column-vector convention
does not test any real transform pipeline

executed.title: Atomic project save (temp in same dir + os.replace) and content-hash identity
executed.rationale: Brief requires recoverable state after interrupted save and explicit source identity; check the safe-save pattern preserves the old file on failure and that sha256 is a byte-sensitive identity.
executed.expected: failed save leaves target byte-identical; successful save replaces atomically; hash stable for identical bytes and different for any change; NOTE a crash between temp-write and replace leaves an orphan temp file (observed) motivating the recovery sweep.
executed.stdout:
target intact after failed save : True True
no leftover temp visible?  files: ['.project-z57qhje0.tmp', 'project.json']
after successful save           : {"v": 2, "ann": ["ok"]}
identity hash stable            : True
any byte change alters identity : True
same-dir rename supported       : True
scope_limits: single process, local tmpfs/ext filesystem; no power-loss/crash injection beyond an exception before replace
cross-filesystem EXDEV and NFS semantics NOT exercised (see V3/V5)
does not establish behavior of any real application

proposed_unexecuted.title: Reopen round-trip on a second machine
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Copy project directory + referenced sources to a second path/user; open; assert annotations bit-identical and relocation dialog appears only for reference-policy sources whose paths moved.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: annotation rows hash-equal pre/post move; no silent relinking when sha256 mismatches.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded-read benchmark on the 8-core/16 GB envelope
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Synthetic 3 GB tiled OME-TIFF + real instrument file; measure p95 tile latency at review zoom, peak RSS, prefetch behavior, cancel latency.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: p95 < 100 ms at review zoom; RSS < 4 GB; cancel < 250 ms. Tests assumption A1.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Kill during save/export on the shared filesystem
proposed_unexecuted.plan: kill -9 mid-save and mid-export on the team's NFS/SMB share; verify old state opens, .partial cleanup, and probe NFS rename caveats (rename(2) BUGS).
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: project opens with last good state; no partially-written authoritative files.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Export->reimport coordinate equality
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Export CSV/GeoJSON; reparse; compare to stored float64 bit-exactly; validate export-manifest transform chain against oplog.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: exact float64 equality; manifest chain matches recorded ops.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Cross-filesystem relocation (EXDEV path)
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move project dir across mounts; verify temp-in-same-dir save avoids EXDEV or falls back to copy+replace safely.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: no save failures; no orphaned authoritative files.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Per-instrument calibration fixture (mirrors tifffile test_issue_tvips_pixelsize)
proposed_unexecuted.plan: For each instrument's files, fixture asserts imported (value, unit) equals file-native values through the workspace import path, so a reader upgrade that changes semantics (as in tifffile 2026.2.24) is caught before annotations are made.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: fixtures fail loudly on any (value, unit) semantic drift.
